name: use-grid-selection
title: useGridSelection
description: A spreadsheet range selection as state, kept by row id and column key: anchor and focus, select, extend, extendTo, row, column and all, and the range's bounds in the current order.

meta.whenToUse: A grid or table with spreadsheet-style cell ranges that must survive reordering, refetching and windowing — DataGrid's cells mode uses it.
meta.whenNotToUse: Row selection with checkboxes (useRowSelection in data-table-parts), or a one-dimensional list (useListNav).
